headline: Sammaan Capital Limited certifies timely debenture interest payment under SEBI Listing Regulations
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited filed a regulatory certification with NSE/BSE confirming timely payment of interest on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued via public issue and listed on the exchanges. The filing is a periodic compliance requirement under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 57.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures through a public issue route and listed them on stock exchanges (NSE/BSE). Per SEBI Regulation 57 (LODR), companies must certify timely payment of interest and principal on all outstanding listed debt instruments. This filing on 30 Jun 2026 is a routine intimation confirming the company discharged its interest obligation on schedule, meeting the exchange disclosure timeline. The debentures are secured instruments, indicating a pledge of company assets as collateral.
